name: Anthropic Admin — Workspaces
description: List workspaces in the Anthropic organization (governance audit input). Requires an admin API key (sk-ant-admin...).

steps.instruction: Sign in at console.anthropic.com with an account that has the Primary Owner role on the organization.
Confirm you understand that an admin API key has org-wide visibility (all workspaces, members, keys).

capture.label: I understand this key grants org-wide visibility and will be stored encrypted in Hakuna's vault.

steps.instruction: Open Settings → Admin Keys → Create new admin API key.
Copy the admin key (starts with sk-ant-admin...).

validation_request.error_message: Could not authenticate with Anthropic Admin API. Verify the key starts with sk-ant-admin and the calling user has Primary Owner role.
